listing.name: Transport Tycoon Deluxe (OpenTTD (upstream))
listing.summary: Upstream route: Mature native reimplementation with free replacement data or original retail data. Limits: Established upstream OpenTTD engine; independent from JGR PatchPack and uses free replacement or owned original data. Upstream platforms: Official Windows/Linux/macOS package routes; macOS universal support documented. Selected Windows/Linux release artifact CPUs unknown in frozen audit. Original data: OpenTTD needs base graphics and sound data. Use the free OpenGFX/OpenSFX sets (OpenMSX supplies optional music), or copy original DOS/Windows Transport Tycoon Deluxe CD graphics/sound files into baseset/. Original commercial TTD assets are optional when using the free sets; original TTD music can be copied separately. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
